description: Files copied from the reference implementation into qrq. Algorithms are unchanged. Paths are relative to the repository root; origins name the stage of the sealed reference archive a file was taken from and are not file-system paths. Every file is pinned by vendored_sha256 and every difference from the original is a classified edit. For Python files, body_sha256 and original_body_sha256 fingerprint the function and class definitions with docstrings and comments removed (tests/test_provenance.py, body_fingerprint); they are equal unless an edit of the class 'hard-coded prices replaced by keyword parameters with identical defaults' is listed.
allowed_edit_classes: hard-coded prices replaced by keyword parameters with identical defaults
